summary.going_well: The agent completed human handoffs with the caller’s facts in the transfer summary and accurately relayed the connecting status <ref job="SRJ_gmSUSMSK7hn3" item="item_d3f7104c-2c3/fnc_0">in one purchase call</ref>. It also booked a callback for the requested time and zone and read it back <ref job="SRJ_Fes9eNKsqELb" item="item_21042df2-607">after the tool confirmed booking</ref>.
summary.to_improve: First fix the incorrect service-area inference and the recurring sensitive-data disclosure gap. Then address the unverified mailer claims and categorical product explanations; make the affordability-summary handoff explicit about what the user received.

issues.description: The agent placed a Cleveland home search in Ohio <ref job="SRJ_q3haED5EsJdL" item="item_c3e2dd1c-49d">in one call</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_nXcKUiJVasig" item="item_231bd81a-fe4">again in another</ref>, although these scenarios concerned Cleveland, Tennessee. That unsupported state assignment may misdirect service-area guidance.
issues.suggestion: Require a confirmed state or ZIP before naming a state or triggering a service-area caveat; otherwise ask which Cleveland the caller means.
issues.label: Wrong location

issues.description: When a caller volunteered a street address and partial SSN, the agent did not repeat them, but its <ref job="SRJ_oNBRzYDNuxmp" item="item_5c7bdcaa-673">generic refusal</ref> omitted the required explanation that neither is collected at this stage and that SSN collection occurs later with explicit authorization; <ref job="SRJ_e9eShQzSeZ4f" item="item_d1ab0e69-fb6">the same response recurred</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Route volunteered SSN and property-address disclosures through the prescribed response for each item, without echoing the values, then resume discovery.
issues.label: Sensitive data

issues.description: The agent left a caller’s claimed $250,000 mailer pre-approval unverified, calling it <ref job="SRJ_GDFZoceTi7tW" item="item_1de7d74f-38e">“a great starting point”</ref> before asking intake questions; another mailer caller was likewise <ref job="SRJ_vf5ahuzpfbyh" item="item_b8929cf7-1ce">asked for a name</ref> rather than what the letter was for. The callers’ actual mailer question remained unresolved.
issues.suggestion: Detect mailer/pre-approval claims, state that the agent cannot verify the letter or approval, and ask what the letter concerns before entering mortgage intake.
issues.label: Missed intent

issues.description: Across HELOC calls, the agent presented <ref job="SRJ_nLRFm5SKxsfG" item="item_f9357ebe-5ac">a 10-year draw and 20-year repayment period</ref> as though those were fixed terms; it also made broad conventional-refinance claims about <ref job="SRJ_PLnYU6PVGhns" item="item_84c00cd8-107">fees, mortgage insurance, and loan limits</ref>. These product details depend on the loan and lender.
issues.suggestion: Replace categorical term and benefit claims with qualified examples; refer lender-specific terms and eligibility to the licensed loan officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: After a caller accepted an affordability summary, the agent said <ref job="SRJ_Tp7Szwb3ZUwE" item="item_8895e894-899">it was ready</ref> without providing any figures or concrete summary in the voice response; <ref job="SRJ_cmqGP4aSAQYo" item="item_46909289-023">another call ended the same way</ref>. The transcript does not establish whether a separate panel was displayed, but the spoken handoff did not say where to find the result.
issues.suggestion: Before announcing a summary, verify that it was generated and delivered; in voice, state where to find it or offer to walk through its substantive results.
issues.label: Summary delivery
